prerequisites: Compatible CUDA/PyTorch/compiler target required by the selected gsplat source. This is not a generic Apple Silicon CPU package. No compiler, GPU, weights or remote worker is provisioned.
lock_resolution: Fetch and check out only this exact commit in a private owned build prefix. Resolve explicit source build-system requirements to a hash lock, build one wheel without build isolation, verify its distribution metadata, resolve runtime dependencies to a second hash lock, sync with required hashes. Retain source/wheel/interpreter/uv identity and all environment file hashes. Repeat commissioning verifies the existing lock without resolving upgrades.
invoke: From a bounded project: nstack run P297 python -- /absolute/project/script.py [arguments]. Use only the registered package API, actual task inputs and current project permissions.
check: nstack check P297 python (actual import and distribution identity only). Then execute the distinct output, negative control and independent comparison from the component acceptance checks; import success is not domain acceptance.
deactivate: Each script exits normally; stop only a task-owned service started by that script after reconciling effects. nstack remove-runtime P297 python quarantines the exact owned environment and lock into private recovery. No global registration is created.
task_prerequisites: Separate CUDA/PyTorch environment, compatible compiler; gsplat rasterization API; calibrated cameras from selected reconstruction lane.
task_acceptance: Render withheld views and compare PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS only for appearance; evaluate geometry independently; record seeds and model/scene checkpoints.
